verse_extent.correction: Previous package incorrectly recorded the chapter as 1-174. Wikisource and the independent E-Bharatisampat witness both show the closing Maṇḍa sequence as verses 173-176.

colophon: इति श्रीदामोदरसूनूना शार्ङ्गधरेण विरचितायां शार्ङ्गधरसंहितायां मध्यमखण्डे क्वाथादिकल्पना नाम द्वितीयोऽध्यायः॥२॥

source_reconciliation.finding: The chapter is explicitly headed क्वाथकल्पना/क्वाथादिकल्पना and runs to verse 174 in the printed Dīpikā witness. BharatKosha reproduces the closing verse and colophon, while Wikisource preserves the chapter sequence and the opening preparation rules.
source_reconciliation.resolution: The working canonical extent is 1-174. Full verse-level Sanskrit should remain tied to the verified witness; no verse is reconstructed from memory.
source_reconciliation.important_note: The chapter expands from basic decoction preparation into many named preparations and dietetic liquids, including mantha, pānaka, yūṣa, manda, and special decoction variants. The repository therefore treats the chapter as a formulation-method chapter rather than only a single kvātha recipe.
source_reconciliation.extent_correction: Chapter 2 closes at verse 176: v173 aṣṭaguṇa-maṇḍa, v174 its concluding description, v175 vāṭyamaṇḍa, v176 lājamaṇḍa, followed by the colophon.

verified_core_verses.text: पानीयं षोडशगुणं क्षुण्णे द्रव्यपले क्षिपेत् । मृत्पात्रे क्वाथयेद्ग्राह्यमष्टमांशावशेषितम् । तज्जलं पाययेद्धीमान्कोष्णं मृद्वग्निसाधितम् ॥ १ ॥
verified_core_verses.meaning: For one pala of coarsely broken drug, use sixteen parts water, cook in an earthen vessel and reduce to one-eighth; the resulting warm decoction is administered.

verified_core_verses.text: शृतः क्वाथः कषायश्च निर्यूहः स निगद्यते ॥ २ ॥
verified_core_verses.meaning: Śṛta, kvātha, kaṣāya and niryūha are names used for this decocted preparation.

verified_core_verses.text: आहाररसपाके च सञ्जाते द्विपलोन्मितम् । वृद्धवैद्योपदेशेन पिबेत्क्वाथं सुपाचितम् ॥ ३ ॥
verified_core_verses.meaning: After digestion of the meal, a properly prepared decoction is taken in the stated two-pala measure according to experienced-physician instruction.

verified_core_verses.text: क्वाथे क्षिपेत्सितामंशैश्चतुर्थाष्टमषोडशैः । वातपित्तकफातङ्के विपरीतं मधु स्मृतम् ॥ ४ ॥
verified_core_verses.meaning: Sugar is added in specified fractional proportions; honey is used inversely in relation to doṣa conditions.

verified_core_verses.text: जीरकं गुग्गुलं क्षारं लवणं च शिलाजतु । हिङ्गु त्रिकटुकं चैव क्वाथे शाणोन्मितं क्षिपेत् ॥ ५ ॥
verified_core_verses.meaning: Certain powdered adjuncts such as cumin, guggulu, kṣāra, salt, śilājatu, hiṅgu and trikatu are added in śāṇa measure.

verified_core_verses.text: क्षीरं घृतं गुडं तैलं मूत्रं चान्यद् द्रवं तथा । कल्कं चूर्णादिकं क्वाथे निक्षिपेत्कर्षसम्मितम् ॥ ६ ॥
verified_core_verses.meaning: Liquid adjuncts and kalka/chūrṇa preparations are added in the specified karṣa measure.
The chapter gives a named yūṣa preparation and describes it as strengthening, throat-supportive, light to digest and kapha-reducing.

verified_core_verses.text: जले चतुर्दशगुणे तण्डुलानां चतुष्पलम् । विपचेत्स्रावयेन्मण्डं स भक्तो मधुरो लघुः ॥ १७१ ॥
verified_core_verses.meaning: Four palas of rice are cooked in fourteen parts water and the liquid portion is separated as manda; the resulting preparation is described as sweet and light.

verified_core_verses.text: नीरे चतुर्दशगुणे सिद्धो मण्डस्त्वसिक्थकः । शुण्ठीसैन्धवसंयुक्तः पाचनो दीपनः परः ॥ १७२ ॥
verified_core_verses.meaning: A rice-water manda prepared with fourteenfold water and combined with śuṇṭhī and saindhava is described as strongly digestive and dīpana.

verified_core_verses.text: धान्यत्रिकटुसिन्धूत्थमुद्गतण्डुलयोजितः । भृष्टश्च हिङ्गुतैलाभ्यां स मण्डोऽष्टगुणः स्मृतः ॥ १७३ ॥
verified_core_verses.meaning: The aṣṭaguṇa manda combines specified grain, trikatu, saindhava, mung and rice ingredients, roasted with hiṅgu and oil.

verified_core_verses.text: दीपनः प्राणदो बस्तिशोधनो रक्तवर्धनः । ज्वरजित्सर्वदोषघ्नो मण्डोऽष्टगुण उच्यते ॥ १७४ ॥
verified_core_verses.meaning: The aṣṭaguṇa manda is described as dīpana, life-supporting, cleansing to the urinary/bladder pathway, blood-promoting, fever-reducing and doṣa-balancing in the classical text.

hindi_learning_summary.summary: क्वाथ-कल्पना में द्रव्य की मात्रा के अनुपात में जल, मृद्वग्नि, अष्टमांशावशेष तथा उपयुक्त प्रक्षेप-द्रव्य मुख्य तकनीकी बिंदु हैं।
अध्याय विभिन्न रोगस्थितियों में अनेक क्वाथ-योग देता है। इन्हें शास्त्रीय formulation examples की तरह पढ़ना चाहिए; आधुनिक prescription equivalence स्वतः नहीं मानना चाहिए।
क्वाथकल्पना आगे विविध preparation-methods और liquid formulations की ओर विस्तृत होती है। प्रत्येक नाम और मात्रा को canonical text से अलग रखकर commentary में व्याख्यायित किया जाना चाहिए।
अंतिम भाग में मन्थ, यूष और मण्ड जैसे आहार-चिकित्सकीय द्रवों का वर्णन आता है; 171-174 में मण्ड की विशिष्ट विधियाँ और गुण मिलते हैं।
